title: Law Beneath the River Mirror
description: Aten Ra advances through floodplain mirrors, collapsing bridges, and corrupted river channels while the Gate tests whether solar law can hold under pressure.
lore: This mission shows the Sun Realm refusing panic: law, river, and battle line answer the Gate wound without rewriting established Canon.
terrain: floodplain mirrors, collapsing bridges, and corrupted river channels

objectives.primary: Move your five-Titan strike force to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it.
optional: Trigger at least two faction synergy actions

specialRules: Mirror Orders: enemies copy the last objective interaction unless interrupted.
Anchor Corruption: structures worsen hazards every two turns.
victoryConditions: Move your five-Titan strike force to the marked solar seal before the Hollow closes around it.

stars.one: Primary completed with one Titan standing or severe turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan Titan; special future modes may override team size explicitly.

recommendedTitans.name: Karnu Glass Horizon
recommendedTitans.reason: Artillery advantage for large enemy groups

recommendedTitans.name: Nefra Obsidian Dawn
recommendedTitans.reason: Controller advantage for large enemy groups

recommendedTitans.name: Amunet Hidden Sun
recommendedTitans.reason: Assassin advantage for large enemy groups

tacticalProfile.rule: Recommended advantages only — any valid active Titan can attempt the mission.
